quarterly_data.signal: CFO Nicky Lee: Q1 2026 revenue rose 12.1% year on year to IDR 15.2 trillion, led by cellular revenue and complemented by the media segment underpinned by GPU revenue; EBITDA rose 12.9% with the margin up 0.4 percentage points to 47.6%; normalized NPAT increased 26.2%; quarter on quarter revenue declined 0.9% on seasonality.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue IDR 15.2 trillion (+12.1%); EBITDA margin 47.6%

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Vikram Sinha: the AI Neo Cloud business recorded $16 million of revenue in Q1 2026 after $28 million in 2025, well on track for the full-year 2026 guidance of around $60 million; firm contracted AI Neo Cloud revenue amounts to $170 million, recognized over 3 years; the business is EPS accretive from day one and FCF positive. CFO Nicky Lee: unleveraged ROIC is around mid-teens, and for the GB200 contract Indosat receives all of its investment upfront.
quarterly_data.figure: AI Neo Cloud firm contracted revenue $170 million; 2026 guidance ~$60 million

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Vikram Sinha: there is significant demand and a shortage across the whole supply-chain ecosystem; H100 capacity renewed with customers on annual contracts saw prices go up by 25% (he also cited an upside of 15%-20% on renewals), the first time this has happened; capacity is all sold out and leased out for the next few months; he expects H100 useful life to be 6 years for sure versus the 5-year depreciation assumed; Indosat has closed a few more contracts and is considering options to scale, with more clarity within a quarter.
quarterly_data.figure: H100 renewal prices up 25%; capacity sold out for next few months

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Vikram Sinha / CFO Nicky Lee: Indosat is tracking ahead of its 2026 guidance after Q1 (12% revenue and 13% EBITDA growth) and will review it after H1; capex was up 59.6% year on year in Q1, 32% of the full-year capex guidance of IDR 13 trillion, spent early by choice; debt-to-EBITDA improved to 0.31 times and net debt fell 9.2% year on year.
quarterly_data.figure: capex guidance IDR 13 trillion; 32% spent in Q1

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Vikram Sinha: customer ARPU reached IDR 45,000 (+15% year on year), the highest since the merger (COO Bilal Kazmi: Q1 exit ARPU IDR 48.6K), with about 80,000 fiber-to-the-home customers added; Indosat launched a partnership with Google bundling Google Gemini subscriptions with its data packages, alongside its Anti-Spam and Anti-Scam service and its own LLM Sahabat-AI (five local languages).

CEO Vikram Sinha: the 5G spectrum auction is scheduled to complete this quarter, with reserve prices down by 60%-70% versus reference bands; the fiber co-asset monetization is on track, with the operating company being set up and closing scheduled in Q3 2026; no decision has been made on the use of proceeds.
quarterly_data.figure: spectrum reserve prices down 60%-70%; fiber transaction closing Q3 2026
